description: Java class defining immutable enumeration data for savings account transaction types in the Fineract project.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionEnumData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing savings account transaction type enumerations.

methods.name: SavingsAccountTransactionEnumData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the enum data based on transaction type ID.

methods.name: isIncomeFromInterest
methods.description: Returns true if the transaction type is overdraft interest.

methods.name: isOverDraftInterestPosting
methods.description: Returns true if the transaction type is overdraft interest posting.

methods.name: isDepositOrWithdrawal
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is either a deposit or a withdrawal.

methods.name: isChargeTransaction
methods.description: Returns true if the transaction is a fee deduction.

methods.name: isAnnualFee
methods.description: Returns true if the transaction is an annual fee.

methods.name: isPayCharge
methods.description: Returns true if the transaction is a pay charge.

methods.name: isWithdrawalFee
methods.description: Returns true if the transaction is a withdrawal fee.

methods.name: isCredit
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a credit.

methods.name: isDebit
methods.description: Checks if the transaction type is a debit.

methods.name: getEntryType
methods.description: Retrieves the entry type of the transaction based on the enum.

methods.name: getTransactionTypeEnum
methods.description: Returns the transaction type enum corresponding to the ID.
